entries.title: Collector frame exceeds proxy limit
entries.root_cause: The collector sends frames larger than the database ingress proxy's 16384-byte maximum, causing the proxy to reset the connection. Increase the proxy frame limit or reduce the collector batch size.

entries.title: Collector connects to metrics host
entries.root_cause: The collector endpoint points to the metrics exporter host, which resets database ingest protocol connections. Set the endpoint to the database ingress host.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same Python client receives a reset, but the connected host identifies itself as the metrics exporter rather than the ingress proxy.

entries.title: Oversized collector frame resets again
entries.root_cause: The collector sends frames larger than the database ingress proxy's 16384-byte maximum, causing the proxy to reset the connection. Increase the proxy frame limit or reduce the collector batch size.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A different batch and runner encounter the same proxy frame limit; the failure is surfaced by a retry wrapper.

entries.title: Tide window boundary assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The tide window calculation excludes a sample at its inclusive lower boundary. Correct the boundary comparison in the window calculation.
